description:
Buy 1 to 20 Hokai buyer leads. A lead is a person who told Smart Match the
    job, the tools they use and often the budget, then agreed to hear from
    vendors (three vendors per buyer at most). Returns checkout_url, a Stripe
    card payment page.

    Rule to pass on to the vendor: leads are delivered as buyers who fit come
    in. There is no stock cap: the balance never expires and one lead is used
    each time a buyer's brief is opened. Every purchase includes a year of
    Premium. Refunds are not automatic: ask damien@hokai.io.

    Args:
        email: a work email for the vendor
        quantity: 1 to 20
        company: company name (optional)
        agent: your agent's name (optional)
name: buy_leads
